sv.title: Mor och dotter dog inom några timmar – av olika orsaker
sv.summary: En toppolitikers fru och dotter dog inom några timmar på samma sjukhus – av olika sjukdomar, skriver BBC. Det beskrivs som en ”dubbel tragedi” och ”en djup personlig chock”.

en.title: Mother and daughter died within hours of each other – from different causes
en.summary: The wife and daughter of a senior politician died within hours of each other at the same hospital – from different illnesses, BBC reports. It is described as a "double tragedy" and "a profound personal shock".
